collection.description: A scholar imagines a way to consult the writings of countless distant people without traveling to their homes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A scholar imagines a way to consult the writings of countless distant people without traveling to their homes.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Researchers sketch a network of copied records and messengers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The system becomes so complex that no one knows which copy is current.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child imagines a smooth tablet displaying changing words; the scholars debate possible mechanisms without naming a real one.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder asks whether a device that contains many claims could distinguish truth from falsehood.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The teacher argues that knowledge should reach children and people with disabilities as well as scholars.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A keeper worries about dangerous misinformation and damaged records; the debate remains unresolved.
